name: External Policy Enforcement
description: Enforce security policy outside the model so generated text cannot self-authorize privileged actions.

name: Instruction / Data Separation
description: Preserve provenance and trust boundaries between control instructions and untrusted content.

name: Tool Capability Allowlist
description: Allow only explicitly approved tools and capabilities for an agent identity.

name: Contextual Tool Authorization
description: Evaluate identity, requested capability, resource and context before each tool action.

name: Human Checkpoint for High-Impact Actions
description: Require explicit approval before high-impact or irreversible actions.

name: Memory Provenance and Scope
description: Track source, scope, expiry and review state for persistent agent memory.

name: RAG Source Provenance
description: Record trust and origin of retrieved documents and preserve that metadata through inference.

name: Untrusted Output Handling
description: Encode, validate or sanitize model output before downstream interpretation or rendering.

name: AI Egress Policy
description: Restrict and monitor network access to model providers and AI gateways by workload identity.

name: AI Asset and Service Inventory
description: Maintain inventory of models, runtimes, agents, gateways, MCP servers and external providers.

name: Artifact Digest Pinning
description: Pin model, package and deployment artifacts to approved immutable digests.

name: Artifact Signature Verification
description: Verify trusted publisher identity and artifact integrity before promotion or execution.

name: Dependency Admission Policy
description: Require provenance, approved registries and review before dependencies suggested by automation are installed.

name: MCP Token Audience Validation
description: Validate that access tokens were issued for the MCP server receiving them; prohibit token passthrough.

name: MCP Explicit User Consent
description: Require clear user consent before connecting servers or invoking consequential tools.

name: MCP State Handle Binding
description: Bind server-side state handles to verified identities and re-authorize every use.

name: AI/ML Bill of Materials
description: Track models, datasets, configurations and dependencies using AI/ML-BOM-capable formats.

name: Secret Isolation
description: Keep model/provider credentials outside prompts and minimize which agents can access them.

name: Agent Action and Resource Budgets
description: Apply hard limits to iterations, tool calls, tokens, time and cost.

name: Agent Decision and Action Telemetry
description: Log identity, plan step, capability request, authorization result and side effect for agent actions.
